- Irregular/angular shape

- Green, otherwise healthy leaf background

Top candidates for leaf disease with small dark spots: **Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato**, **Septoria_Leaf_Blotch**, **Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus**.

- The angular/irregular shape of spots matches bacterial speck
- The test image Bugwood number (1573573) is consecutive with the reference (1573569), strongly suggesting same disease collection
- No prominent yellow halos in test image, but the spots are clearly small dark specks
- The concentric-ring appearance in one lesion at bottom right is unusual for bacterial speck, but could be an overlapping/coalescing lesion

The small, dark, angular spots on a green leaf, combined with the Bugwood series number alignment, points to **Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato**.
